purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review.
assessment: George Town identity is tied to the exact Penang WUP point [5.37296693960077, 100.295715284095]. An official public Penang cadastral Polygon layer returned one full, closed parcel at that point using explicit EPSG:4326 input/output and safe native parcel-key fields. No property-owner, address or account lookup was submitted. One full geometry sample with only parcel keys and area was retained.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Penang GeoHub describes public geospatial applications and open geospatial data; it gives its state geospatial-management contact in George Town.
Official PEGIS ArcGIS metadata exposes a `Maklumat Lot` Polygon Feature Layer with JSON/GeoJSON/PBF query formats, pagination, and parcel-key fields (lot, UPI, area, administrative locality).

Official Malaysian forestry GIS lists Penang `Lot Kadaster` as a polygon feature layer, credits JUPEM 2020 and exposes MUKIM, PA, LOT, UPI and KELUASAN fields; source spatial reference is EPSG:102062.
Official Penang PgLAND land-administration portal lists the Timur Laut District and Land Office, including a land-registration unit, at KOMTAR, 10000 Pulau Pinang (George Town).
Official Department of Survey and Mapping Malaysia lists MyLot as an online land-lot location and boundary application and eKadaster as its cadastral information service.

rootRuntimeAssessment.purpose: Root public-source identity, topology and verified TLS review.
rootRuntimeAssessment.scope: 143 valid distinct JUPEM Penang cadastral-reference lots verified in thirteen bounded 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged George Town metropolitan WUP locator. The Forestry government GIS host supplies native UPI identity and FID transport IDs; variable-length native UPI strings are preserved without padding, truncation or substitution. Complete object-ID manifests, forced three-row geometry pages (56 parcels over 19 pages), all 143 fresh native-ID reads, explicit absence, footprint and source binding passed in 80 requests. Independent metric EPSG:32647 GEOS found all geometries valid and distinct, with no sampled overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. The missing TLS intermediate is supplied from the official GlobalSign CA with certificate and hostname verification enabled for every runtime request; no runtime verification bypass is used. The publisher credits JUPEM 2020 and declares source CRS as ArcGIS WKID 102062; explicit EPSG:4326 output is retained unchanged. This is bounded metropolitan reference geometry, without claims of George Town municipal-only or citywide completeness, legal title, currentness, survey accuracy or long-term key continuity.
